changeinfo.changes: * Fixed stomper collision: you now get knocked out of harm's way rather than taking continuous damage * Fixed damage effect for off-screen sandcrawler gun turrets * Multiplier now correctly resets after expiring * Fixed graphical glitches in Sarlacc * Fixed time and fuel it takes to reach the Sandcrawler and Mos Eisley * Corrected thermal detonator's effect on environmental objects * Fixed player action getting stuck momentarily when certain bosses spawned * Added SLOWDOWN Option (see manual) to simulate the average reduced speed of game play in side-view levels due to hardware slow down in the original 1992 game * Adjusted slide distance to simulate effects of slowdown on original hardware * Updated game credits
